title: The Current of the Upper Fly River
author: Isandro Amberdale
blurb: Quentin Underhill, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
